consequence.statement: A new optional flag was added to istioctl analyze; nothing fails or changes for existing usage.

original.statement: A new flag `remote-contexts` was added to `istioctl analyze` to specify remote cluster contexts during multi-cluster analysis.

decision.reason: [ev-a2198475a8e4] describes only an addition: a new `remote-contexts` flag on `istioctl analyze` for naming remote cluster contexts in multi-cluster analysis. It does not say that any existing flag, default or behaviour changes, or that anything fails or must be migrated. An operator who does nothing has no operational consequence, so kind none (informational) fits. The evidence does not literally call the flag optional; I inferred that from the fact that it is an addition.
